purpose: Resolve the byte-archive requirement using a machine-readable representation of the same fixed official Binance Support article identities without traversing announcement lists, current exchange metadata, 2025 pages, or 2026 pages.

transport.article_codes_source: The 33 already-reconstructed official Support detail URLs for Launchpool project numbers 31 through 63 in BNB_LAUNCHPOOL_DEMAND_001_SOURCE_RECON_V0.1.json

content_integrity_contract.publication_timestamp_rule: When the response exposes a parseable original release/publish timestamp, it must equal the prospectively reconstructed official Published-on timestamp for that event. Missing or contradictory original publication metadata fails closed.
content_integrity_contract.bnb_evidence_rule: The official article content must contain BNB and farming/staking/locking/Launchpool language sufficient to support the frozen event inclusion rule.
content_integrity_contract.project_identity_rule: The response must identify the expected token symbol and Launchpool context for the fixed article code.
